title: Exploring the properties, types, and performance of atomic site catalysts in electrochemical hydrogen evolution reactions
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00333K, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
M. Nur Hossain, Lei Zhang, Roberto Neagu, Shuhui Sun
This review investigates atomic site catalysts (ASCs) for electrochemical hydrogen evolution reaction (HER), discussing their properties, types, performance, significance, activity, selectivity, stability, challenges, and future research directions.
